hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ ! -f package.json ]; then exit 0; fi; RC=0; echo "\n=== tsc ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; RC=$((RC + $?)); echo "=== lint ==="; npm run lint --if-present 2>&1 | tail -20; RC=$((RC + $?)); echo "=== tests ==="; npm test -- --passWithNoTests --bail 1 2>&1 | tail -20; RC=$((RC + $?)); exit $RC'
